applied.quote: Working on Mercor involves significant freelance friction that every applicant should consider. The company delivers real weekly payments for completed work, but contractors should treat it as variable project income rather than dependable primary wages.
applied.replacement: Mercor's work comes in client projects that can end or be re-priced. Mercor also had a data breach in late March 2026 linked to a LiteLLM supply-chain attack. Contractors then filed eight federal class actions alleging their data was exposed. Mercor pays weekly for completed work, so treat it as variable project income instead of a dependable primary wage.
